title: Portland Meadows Stand Off: A-K decision sequence
author: Nolan Kido
source_kind: Participant's archived v9 final production script and source-verification ledger; not an independently checked current YouTube cut
public_release_status: Supplementary source review only, not a timecode-verified stand-alone video companion

event.format: 12-round Stand Off, survivors paid according to ICM stacks after round twelve, as described in recorded narration
event.result: Player reports busting in round 10 and not cashing

decision.later_read: At the hotel, Nolan reasoned that the big blind might call weaker premiums rather than shove, and said he would prefer folding to the new action. This is a retrospective hypothesis, not a validated range.
decision.immediate_after_hand_opinion: Immediately after the bust, Nolan stated that he did not think he could fold.

editorial_rule: First decision to flat and second decision facing two shoves must be presented separately. A change in the action changes the question. No invented board, opponent suits, exact payout, ICM percent, or current-cut chapter times.
